WWE SummerSlam Features Reigns, Rollins in Major Matches

WWE SummerSlam Night 2 saw Roman Reigns defeat Seth Rollins for the World Heavyweight Championship. Despite the loss, Rollins was noted for delivering the night's most physical performance. In another match, Kevin Owens became the new number one contender by winning a fatal four-way bout. The event also featured Brock Lesnar, whose post-match actions were noted.
